label: Sunburst
blurb: Spokes of light shoot out from a point and the incoming shot comes in along them. The rays are not all the same: long thin ones run between broad ones, they lengthen at different speeds, and the whole fan turns as it grows so the frame looks like it is winding open. The leading tip of each ray burns bright and the ray behind it fills with the new picture. Set where the middle is, how many rays there are, how far they are tapered, how fast the fan turns and how hot the tips burn.
